tspan.tspan: GL Intraday Processing for Intraday Cubes: Warehouse Cycle - Triggers
For dummy shout job nwglshw#, where # = 2,3,4 ; Run cycle is ALL days of year

- Job nwglfjw1 is a dummy job that dynamically loads tables NWGLINTRAD1, NWZ2INTRACM, job nwz2msi1 (Table: NWZ2INTRADC) and job nwgldcw1 (TABLE: NWGLINTRADC) into the active plan on NWPROD (Refer opcglintra_wh & opcz2intra2)
- Jobs nwglfjc1 is a dummy job that dynamically loads tables NWZ2INTRACM and job nwz2dci1 (Table: NWZ2INTRADC) into the active plan on CTMPROD (Refer opcz2intra2)

- Job nwglmsw1 end-of-stream job. It sends out shout if late submission (Note: as this job scheduled to run before new active plan roll in at 08:00, the shout is imbedded in this job, no dummy shout job is required)
- Job nwglcjw1 is dummy job that waits for user confirmation. It may be used to cancel Run 1.
When confirmed, it adds in the necessary conditions to kick off job nwglmsw1 and remove the condition S1 (NWGLINTRA_RUN_1 for current ODATE)

- Job nwglfjw2 is a dummy job that dynamically loads tables NWGLINTRAD1, NWZ2INTRACM, job nwz2msi2 (Table: NWZ2INTRADC) and job nwgldcw2 (TABLE: NWGLINTRADC) into the active plan on NWPROD (Refer opcglintra_wh & opcz2intra2)
- Jobs nwglfjc2 is a dummy job that dynamically loads tables NWZ2INTRACM and job nwz2dci2 (Table: NWZ2INTRADC) into the active plan on CTMPROD (Refer opcz2intra2)

- Job nwglshw2 is dummy shout job, roll in daily to check if run#2 is late. It needed to be a dummy job with hooking to “maybe” cond of prev ODATE of job nwglmsw2 as Latesub shout condition has no ODATE. It checks for run#2 that was ordered in on
the previous ODATE but due to run today
- Job nwglcjw2 is dummy job that waits for user confirmation. It may be used to cancel Run 2.
When confirmed, it adds in the necessary conditions to kick off job nwglmsw2 remove the condition S2 (NWGLINTRA_RUN_2 for current ODATE)
: The condition S0 (NW_GL_INTRA for current ODATE) is added in at the beginning of the daily batch by job nwgltgws. It’s a pre-req to all runs thru out the day.
It purpose is to prevent non-consecutive run being avertedly triggered in when a run is in progress.
Once a run is kicked in, the condition S0 is removed by job nwglfjw# and is added back in by job nwglmsw# at the end of the run.

- Job nwglfjw3 is a dummy job that dynamically loads tables NWGLINTRAD1, NWZ2INTRACM, job nwz2msi3 (Table: NWZ2INTRADC) and job nwgldcw3 (TABLE: NWGLINTRADC) into the active plan on NWPROD (Refer opcglintra_wh & opcz2intra2)
- Jobs nwglfjc3 is a dummy job that dynamically loads tables NWZ2INTRACM and job nwz2dci3 (Table: NWZ2INTRADC) into the active plan on CTMPROD (Refer opcz2intra2)

- Job nwglshw3 is a dummy shout job, roll in daily to check if run#3 is late. It needed to be a dummy job with hooking to “maybe” cond of prev ODATE of job nwglmsw3 as Latesub shout cond has no ODATE. It checks for run#3 that was ordered in on
previous ODATE but is due to run today.
- Job nwglcjw3 is dummy job that waits for user confirmation. It may be used to cancel Run 3.
When confirmed, it adds in the necessary conditions to kick off job nwglmsw3 and remove the condition S3 (NWGLINTRA_RUN_3 for current ODATE)

- Job nwglfjw4 is a dummy job that dynamically loads tables NWGLINTRAD1, NWZ2INTRACM, job nwz2msi4 (Table: NWZ2INTRADC) and job nwgldcw4 (TABLE: NWGLINTRADC) into the active plan on NWPROD (Refer opcglintra_wh & opcz2intra2)
- Jobs nwglfjc4 is a dummy job that dynamically loads tables NWZ2INTRACM and job nwz2dci4 (Table: NWZ2INTRADC) into the active plan on CTMPROD (Refer opcz2intra2)

- Job nwglshw4 is a dummy shout job, roll in daily to check if run#4 is late. It needed to be a dummy job with hooking to “maybe” cond of prev ODATE of job nwglmsw4 as Latesub shout cond has no ODATE. It checks for run#4 that was ordered in on
previous ODATE but is due to run today.
- Job nwglcjw4 is dummy job that waits for user confirmation. It may be used to cancel Run 4.
When confirmed, it adds in the necessary conditions to kick off job nwglmsw4 and remove the condition S4 (NWGLINTRA_RUN_4 for current ODATE)
